class.name: NetwDisplayHandle
class.brief_description: How one [NetwEntity] is drawn, reached by [member NetwEntity.interpolation].
class.description: A [NetwInterpolate] configures one property. This handle holds the settings that apply to the whole entity, such as which node receives the smoothed values and how far behind the newest snapshot it is drawn. [codeblock] var handle := NetwEntity.of(self).interpolation handle.visual_root = NodePath("Visual") handle.display_role = NetwMultiplayer.DISPLAY_ROLE_REMOTE [/codeblock] Settings written before the entity is spawned are applied once it is, and they are kept if the entity respawns.

method.name: displayed_authoring_tick
method.description: The tick the drawn state was written at, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: entity
method.description: The [NetwEntity] this handle belongs to, or [code]null[/code] once that entity is gone.

method.name: get_buffer
method.description: The [NetwRingBuffer] of snapshots for [param property], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears the entity's interpolation history and writes its current values to the visual. Call it after teleporting the entity locally, so it does not interpolate from the old position.

members.member: The extra display delay in ticks that [member enable_smart_dilation] has added.
How this entity is drawn. [constant NetwMultiplayer.DISPLAY_ROLE_AUTO] picks one from [member NetwSimulationHandle.mode] and who controls the entity, and is right for most entities.
Lets the display delay of a remote entity grow when snapshots arrive late.
Per frame fraction used to low pass the lag floor.
Per frame fraction used to track the measured lag floor.
How an entity this peer simulates is drawn under [constant NetwMultiplayer.DISPLAY_ROLE_PREDICTED], in [constant NetwSimulationHandle.MODE_PREDICT] or [constant NetwSimulationHandle.MODE_ACTIVE].
Smoothing time in seconds for [constant NetwMultiplayer.LIVE_MODE_CHASE]. [code]0[/code] uses one tick.
The most ticks [member display_lag] may grow to.
How many frames without a new snapshot are tolerated before [member display_lag] starts growing.
Ticks added to [member display_lag] per frame once the grace frames are spent.
Frames between interpolation trace logs. [code]0[/code] disables them.

The child node that receives the smoothed values. Position and rotation are written in global space, and other properties are written as they are. A visual with [member CanvasItem.top_level] set receives every property in global space.
